limits: Static reviews and a source bridge do not replace final candidate quality or exact-head CI.
The original 555-entry executable inventory is historical; only the 188-entry product and packaging byte identity is carried to the candidate.
No actual process, signal, GPU, network, provider or new platform acceptance is claimed by these portable unit tests.
test_changes: Caller warning filters are explicit synthetic test inputs; production warning behavior is unchanged.
HTTP retry-clock and isolated-worker user identity are test-local doubles.
Native-peer run units use a non-Linux worker-I/O double; genuine Linux worker and descriptor tests retain their gates.
Existing pure cancellation summary checks moved out of a Linux-only file without losing their six cases.
New BytesIO log tests cover complete-line/privacy-window/digest budgets without real owned-log I/O.
New cancellation snapshot and state tests use only virtual handles, explicit process doubles and module-local clocks; real signals and platform capabilities remain untouched.
